# Fotobank

> Fotobank is a photo system of record for you and your agents, built on embedded Docbank. It is pre-alpha software with no stability guarantees. Keep independent copies of irreplaceable photos.

## Product overview

- [Website Markdown](/index.md): What Fotobank does, related Kenn projects, and pre-alpha limits.
- [Storage and editing guide](/guide.md): How one photograph moves from import through backup and restore.
- [Changelog](/docs/changelog/): New features, improvements, and bug fixes in 0.1.0.

## User and agent workflows

- [Set up for someone else](/docs/guides/agent-setup/): Decisions, first-import checks, recovery drill, and operator handoff.
- [Files and previews](/docs/guides/formats/): Import versus preview support, RAW files, color profiles, and video limits.
- [Optional AI](/docs/guides/ai/): Provider setup, processing consent, cost considerations, and disabling AI.
- [Setup](/docs/guides/setup/): Build the 0.1.0 source tag, configure storage, start the daemon, and try a first import and backup.
- [Browse and find photos](/docs/guides/browse/): Browse, search, select photos, organize albums, and download originals in the web app.
- [Import photos](/docs/guides/import/): Import, finish interrupted imports, and refresh photo locations through the daemon, with structured results for automation.
- [Edit files in a checkout](/docs/guides/checkouts/): Create working copies, scan edits, inspect saved state, and explicitly commit.
- [Backup and restore](/docs/guides/backup/): Archive both the catalog and content, schedule backups, and restore separately.
- [Automation](/docs/guides/automation/): List, search, and inspect photos through the daemon; structured output and current command and API limits. MCP integration is not implemented.

## Technical documentation

- [Documentation](/docs/): Guides and current architecture.
- [System map](/docs/architecture/): Package ownership and rules for changing the code.
- [Content and storage](/docs/architecture/content-and-storage/): Docbank, NAS, thumbnails, imports, and checkouts.
- [Data model](/docs/architecture/data-model/): Assets, files, albums, shares, and ownership.
- [Search and AI](/docs/architecture/search-and-ai/): Current search and optional AI implementation.
